# Muslim Prayer Reminder MCP

> Production-ready Islamic prayer reminder system exposing a Streamable HTTP Model Context Protocol (MCP) server on Cloudflare Workers and a portable local runner for AI agents.

## Core Capabilities
- Sub-minute astronomical calculation of Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha.
- Supports 12 global calculation conventions (UmmAlQura, MuslimWorldLeague, Egyptian, Karachi, Dubai, Qatar, Kuwait, Singapore, MoonsightingCommittee, NorthAmerica, Tehran, Turkey).
- High-latitude polar day/night clamping (MiddleOfTheNight, SeventhOfTheNight, TwilightAngle).
- Deterministic response middleware for AI chat applications (<5ms overhead).
- Strict privacy: 2-decimal coordinate sanitization (~1.1km fuzzing), zero tracking, in-isolate computation.

## Endpoints
- Remote Streamable HTTP MCP: https://muslim-prayer-mcp.najetareqz.workers.dev/mcp
- Discovery Server Card: https://muslim-prayer-mcp.najetareqz.workers.dev/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- Health: https://muslim-prayer-mcp.najetareqz.workers.dev/health
- Security Policy: https://muslim-prayer-mcp.najetareqz.workers.dev/.well-known/security.txt
